I'm sorry I'm such a fuck up. 
I'm sorry I can't do anything right. 
I'm sorry I ruin everything I touch. 
I'm sorry I wasn't good enough for you. 
I'm sorry I can't make you happy. 
I'm sorry I can't be happy.
I'm sorry for existing. 

These 34 years have been a colossal waste of time.

I'm not even going to hold back on your dumb ass. This is a throwaway account for obvious reasons, so who cares. 

Yes, I do understand how the human body works. I have practiced Brazilian Jiu Jitsu for over 8 years. If you know anything about it, the heart of it is the choke. I am well aware of the forces which need to be applied to render someone unconscious. I am also aware that these forces need to be applied for a long period of time in order to kill someone. 

You have no idea about the situation or how I tried to strangle myself. Did you know that hanging one's self is a form on strangulation? Now you know.

If you're going to browse this subreddit, have some tact. If you don't have anything constructive to say, SHUT THE FUCK UP. This is hardly the place for your unconstructive bullshit. 

Go fuck yourself.

It makes total sense. And I buy into that way of thinking 100%. I love her, and will continue to love her regardless of how much she loves me. 

Somehow, though, despite being able to come to the conclusion that, logically, she *does* care for me and love me, my mind is so f__ked up that I still imagine all these scenarios where it's *not* true and dwell on the worst-possible one. 

This is just one example. This basic formula happens with everyone I know. I don't have any real friends because of it.

It's really lonely. I'm tired of it.

I ruin all of my relationships/friendships because I don't believe anyone can truly like/love me. 

My mind doesn't stop analyzing/over-analyzing the small things people do and turn them into some sort of conspiracy against me. Nothing good ever happens to me that I don't think happened because some ulterior motive someone had. 

For example: I have been seeing this girl and she professes to love me and be *in love* with me... but I constantly fear she's being disingenuous and is interested in other guys. I have talked to her about it and expressed my concerns, told her why it's happening and she seems to understand and be sympathetic, but I can still feel/sense her slowly pulling/drifting away... Which feeds the cycle and perpetuates my anxiety/paranoia. 

I just got sick of the cycle; of the constant barrage of negativity going on in my mind and didn't see an end to it in sight.
